ayahs.1: Logo! Apne Parwardigar se daro! Bila-shubha qayamat ka zalzala bahut hi badi cheez hai.
ayahs.2: Jis din tum use dekh lo ge har doodh pilaane wali apne doodh peete bachche ko bhool jaayegi aur tamaam hamal waliyon ke hamal gir jaayenge aur tu dekhe ga ke log madhosh dikhaai denge, halaanke dar-haqeeqat woh matwaale na honge lekin Allah ka azaab bada hi sakht hai.
ayahs.3: Baaz log Allah ke baare mein baaten banaate hain aur woh bhi be-ilmi ke saath aur har sarkash shaytaan ki pairwi karte hain.
ayahs.4: Jis par (qaza-e-Ilahi) likh di gayi hai ke jo koi us ki rafaaqat karega woh use gumraah kar dega aur use aag ke azaab ki taraf le jaayega.
ayahs.5: Logo! Agar tumhein marne ke baad jee uthne mein shak hai to socho hum ne tumhein mitti se paida kiya phir nutfa se phir khoon-basta se phir gosht ke lothde se jo soorat diya gaya tha aur be-naqsha tha. Yeh hum tum par zaahir kar dete hain, aur hum jise chaahein ek thehraaye hue waqt tak rehm-e-madar mein rakhte hain phir tumhein bachpan ki haalat mein dunya mein laate hain phir taake tum apni poori jawaani ko pahuncho, tum mein se baaz to woh hain jo faut kar liye jaate hain aur baaz be-ghaz umr ki taraf phir se lauta diye jaate hain ke woh ek cheez se ba-khabar hone ke baad phir be-khabar ho jaaye. To dekhta hai ke zameen (banjar aur) khushk hai phir hum us par baarishen barsaate hain to woh ubharti hai aur phoolti hai aur har qism ki raunaq-daar nabataat ugaati hai.
ayahs.6: Yeh is liye ke Allah hi haq hai aur wahi murdon ko jilaata hai aur woh har cheez par qudrat rakhne wala hai.
ayahs.7: Aur yeh ke qayamat qatan aane wali hai jis mein koi shak-o-shubha nahin aur yaqeenan Allah Taala qabron walon ko dobaara zinda farmaayega.
ayahs.8: Baaz log Allah ke baare mein baghair ilm ke aur baghair hidayat ke aur baghair roshan kitaab ke jhagadte hain.
ayahs.9: Jo apni pehlu modne wala ban kar is liye ke Allah ki raah se behka de, use dunya mein bhi ruswaai hogi aur qayamat ke din bhi hum use jahannam mein jalne ka azaab chakhayenge.
ayahs.10: Yeh un aamaal ki wajah se jo tere haathon ne aage bhej rakhe the. Yaqeen maano ke Allah Taala apne bandon par zulm karne wala nahin.
ayahs.11: Baaz log aise bhi hain ke ek kinaare par (khade) ho kar Allah ki ibaadat karte hain. Agar koi nafa mil gaya to dilchaspi lene lagte hain aur agar koi aafat aa gayi to isi waqt munh pher lete hain, unhon ne donon jahaan ka nuqsaan utha liya. Waaqai yeh khula nuqsaan hai.
ayahs.12: Allah ke siwa unhein pukaarte hain jo na unhein nuqsaan pahuncha saken na nafa. Yehi to door-daraaz ki gumraahi hai.
ayahs.13: Use pukaarte hain jis ka nuqsaan us ke nafa se ziyaada qareeb hai, yaqeenan bure wali hain aur bure saathi.
ayahs.14: Imaan aur nek aamaal walon ko Allah Taala behti hui nehron wali jannaton mein daakhil karega. Allah jo irada kare use kar ke rehta hai.
ayahs.15: Jis ka yeh khayal ho ke Allah Taala apne Rasool ki madad donon jahaan mein na karega woh oonchaai par ek rassa baandh kar (apne halq mein phanda daal kar apna gala ghont le) phir dekh le ke us ki chaalakiyon se woh baat hat jaati hai jo use tadpa rahi hai?
ayahs.16: Hum ne isi tarah is Quran ko waazeh aayaton mein utaara hai jise Allah chaahe hidayat naseeb farmaata hai.
ayahs.17: Beshak ahl-e-imaan aur yahoodi aur saabi aur nasraani aur majoosi aur mushrikeen in sab ke darmiyaan qayamat ke din khud Allah Taala faisle kar dega, Allah Taala har cheez par gawaah hai.
ayahs.18: Kya tu nahin dekh raha ke Allah ke saamne sajde mein hain sab aasmanon wale aur sab zameenon wale aur sooraj aur chaand aur sitaare aur pahaad aur darakht aur jaanwar aur bahut se insan bhi. Haan bahut se woh bhi hain jin par azaab ka maqoola saabit ho chuka hai, jise Rabb zaleel kar de use koi izzat dene wala nahin, Allah jo chaahta hai karta hai.
ayahs.19: Yeh donon apne Rabb ke baare mein ikhtilaaf karne wale hain, pas kaafiron ke liye to aag ke kapde biyunt kar kaate jaayenge, aur un ke saron ke oopar se sakht khaulta hua paani bahaaya jaayega.
ayahs.20: Jis se un ke pet ki sab cheezen aur khaalain gala di jaayengi.
ayahs.21: Aur un ki saza ke liye lohe ke hathode hain.
ayahs.22: Yeh jab bhi wahan ke gham se nikal bhaagne ka irada karenge wahin lauta diye jaayenge aur (kaha jaayega) jalne ka azaab chakhho!
ayahs.23: Imaan walon aur nek kaam walon ko Allah Taala un jannaton mein le jaayega jin ke darakhton tale se nehren lehrain le rahi hain, jahan woh sone ke kangan pehnaaye jaayenge aur sachche moti bhi. Wahan un ka libaas khaalis resham hoga.
ayahs.24: Un ko pakeeza baat ki rehnumaai kar di gayi aur qaabil-e-sad tareef raah ki hidayat kar di gayi.
ayahs.25: Jin logon ne kufr kiya aur Allah ki raah se rokne lage aur us hurmat wali masjid se bhi jise hum ne tamaam logon ke liye musaawi kar diya hai wahin ke rehne wale hon ya baahar ke hon, jo bhi zulm ke saath wahan ilhaad ka irada kare hum use dardnaak azaab chakhayenge.
ayahs.26: Aur jabke hum ne Ibraheem (alaihis salaam) ko Kaaba ke makaan ki jagah muqarrar kar di is shart par ke mere saath kisi ko shareek na karna aur mere ghar ko tawaaf, qiyaam, ruku, sajda karne walon ke liye paak saaf rakhna.
ayahs.27: Aur logon mein hajj ki munaadi kar de log tere paas pa-piyada bhi aayenge aur duble patle oonton par bhi aur door-daraaz ki tamaam raahon se aayenge.
ayahs.28: Apne faaide haasil karne ko aa jaayen aur in muqarrara dinon mein Allah ka naam yaad karen aur chaupaayon par jo paalto hain. Pas tum aap bhi khaao aur bhooke faqeeron ko bhi khilaao.
ayahs.29: Phir woh apna mail-kuchail door karen aur apni nazren poori karen aur Allah ke qadeem ghar ka tawaaf karen.
ayahs.30: Yeh hai aur jo koi Allah ki hurmaton ki tazeem kare us ke apne liye us ke Rabb ke paas behtari hai. Aur tumhare liye chaupaaye jaanwar halaal kar diye gaye bajuz un ke jo tumhare saamne bayan kiye gaye hain pas tumhein buton ki gandagi se bachte rehna chaahiye aur jhooti baat se bhi parhez karna chaahiye.
ayahs.31: Allah ki tauheed ko maante hue us ke saath kisi ko shareek na karte hue. Suno! Allah ke saath shareek karne wala goya aasman se gir pada, ab ya to use parinde uchak le jaayenge ya hawa kisi door-daraaz ki jagah phenk degi.
ayahs.32: Yeh sun liya ab aur suno! Allah ki nishaaniyon ki jo izzat-o-hurmat kare us ke dil ki parhezgaari ki wajah se yeh hai.
ayahs.33: In mein tumhare liye ek muqarrar waqt tak faaida hai phir un ke halaal hone ki jagah khana-e-Kaaba hai.
ayahs.34: Aur har ummat ke liye hum ne qurbani ke tareeqe muqarrar farmaaye hain taake woh in chaupaaye jaanwaron par Allah ka naam len jo Allah ne unhein de rakhe hain. Samajh lo ke tum sab ka mabood-e-bar-haq sirf ek hi hai tum isi ke taabe farmaan ho jaao, aajizi karne walon ko khushkhabri suna dijiye!
ayahs.35: Unhein ke jab Allah ka zikr kiya jaaye un ke dil tharra jaate hain. Unhein jo buraai pahunche us par sabr karte hain, namaz qaaim karne wale hain aur jo kuchh hum ne unhein de rakha hai woh us mein se bhi dete rehte hain.
ayahs.36: Qurbani ke oont hum ne tumhare liye Allah Taala ki nishaaniyan muqarrar kar di hain in mein tumhein nafa hai. Pas unhein khada kar ke un par Allah ka naam lo, phir jab un ke pehlu zameen se lag jaayen use (khud bhi) khaao aur miskeen sawaal se rukne walon aur sawaal karne walon ko bhi khilaao, isi tarah hum ne chaupaayon ko tumhare matahat kar diya hai ke tum shukr-guzaari karo.
ayahs.37: Allah Taala ko qurbaniyon ke gosht nahin pahunchte na us ke khoon balke use to tumhare dil ki parhezgaari pahunchti hai. Isi tarah Allah ne in jaanwaron ko tumhare mutee kar diya hai ke tum us ki rehnumaai ke shukriye mein us ki badaaiyan bayan karo, aur nek logon ko khushkhabri suna dijiye!
ayahs.38: Sun rakho! Yaqeenan sachche mominon ke dushmanon ko khud Allah Taala hata deta hai. Koi khiyanat karne wala na-shukra Allah Taala ko hargiz pasand nahin.
ayahs.39: Jin (musalmanon) se (kaafir) jang kar rahe hain unhein bhi muqaable ki ijaazat di jaati hai kyunke woh mazloom hain. Beshak un ki madad par Allah qaadir hai.
ayahs.40: Yeh woh hain jinhein na-haq apne gharon se nikaala gaya, sirf un ke is qaul par ke hamara Parwardigar faqat Allah hai. Agar Allah Taala logon ko aapas mein ek doosre se na hataata rehta to ibaadat-khane aur girje aur masjiden aur yahoodiyon ke maabad aur woh masjiden bhi dha di jaatin jahan Allah ka naam ba-kasrat liya jaata hai. Jo Allah ki madad karega Allah bhi zaroor us ki madad karega. Beshak Allah Taala badi quwwaton wala bade ghalbe wala hai.
ayahs.41: Yeh woh log hain ke agar hum zameen mein un ke paaon jama den to yeh poori paabandi se namazen qaaim karen aur zakaaten den aur achchhe kaamon ka hukm karen aur bure kaamon se mana karen. Tamaam kaamon ka anjaam Allah ke ikhtiyaar mein hai.
ayahs.42: Agar yeh log aap ko jhutlaayen (to koi taajjub ki baat nahin) to un se pehle Nooh ki qaum aur Aad aur Samood.
ayahs.44: Aur Madyan wale bhi apne apne nabiyon ko jhutla chuke hain. Moosa (alaihis salaam) bhi jhutlaaye ja chuke hain pas main ne kaafiron ko yun hi si mohlat di phir dhar dabocha, phir mera azaab kaisa hua?
ayahs.45: Bahut si bastiyan hain jinhein hum ne teh-o-baala kar diya is liye ke woh zaalim the pas woh apni chhaton ke bal aundhi hui padi hain aur bahut se aabaad kuwen bekaar pade hain aur bahut se pakke aur buland mahal veeran pade hain.
ayahs.46: Kya unhon ne zameen mein sair-o-siyaahat nahin ki jo un ke dil in baaton ke samajhne wale hote ya kaanon se hi in (waqiaat) ko sun lete, baat yeh hai ke sirf aankhen hi andhi nahin hotin balke woh dil andhe ho jaate hain jo seenon mein hain.
ayahs.47: Allah hargiz apna wada nahin taalega. Haan albatta aap ke Rabb ke nazdeek ek din tumhari ginti ke aitibaar se ek hazaar saal ka hai.
ayahs.48: Bahut si zulm karne wali bastiyon ko main ne dheel di phir aakhir unhein pakad liya, aur meri hi taraf laut kar aana hai.
ayahs.49: Ailaan kar do ke logo! Main tumhein khullam-khulla chaukanna karne wala hi hoon.
ayahs.50: Pas jo imaan laaye hain aur jinhon ne nek amal kiye hain un hi ke liye bakhshish hai aur izzat wali rozi.
ayahs.51: Aur jo log hamari nishaaniyon ko past karne ke darpe rehte hain wohi dozakhhi hain.
ayahs.52: Hum ne aap se pehle jis Rasool aur nabi ko bheja us ke saath yeh hua ke jab woh apne dil mein koi aarzoo karne laga shaytaan ne us ki aarzoo mein kuchh mila diya, pas shaytaan ki milaawat ko Allah Taala door kar deta hai phir apni baaten pakki kar deta hai. Allah Taala daana aur ba-hikmat hai.
ayahs.53: Yeh is liye ke shaytaani milaawat ko Allah Taala un logon ki aazmaaish ka zariya bana de jin ke dilon mein bimaari hai aur jin ke dil sakht hain. Beshak zaalim log gehri mukhalifat mein hain.
ayahs.54: Aur is liye bhi ke jinhein ilm ata farmaaya gaya hai woh yaqeen kar len ke yeh aap ke Rabb hi ki taraf se sarasar haq hi hai phir woh us par imaan laayen aur un ke dil us ki taraf jhuk jaayen. Yaqeenan Allah Taala imaan-daaron ko raah-e-raast ki taraf rehbari karne wala hi hai.
ayahs.55: Kaafir is wahi-e-Ilahi mein hamesha shak-shubha hi karte rahenge hatta ke achaanak un ke saron par qayamat aa jaaye ya un ke paas us din ka azaab aa jaaye jo manhoos hai.
ayahs.56: Us din sirf Allah hi ki baadshaahat hogi wahi un mein faisle farmaayega. Imaan aur nek amal wale to ne'maton se bhari jannaton mein honge.
ayahs.57: Aur jin logon ne kufr kiya aur hamari aayaton ko jhutlaaya un ke liye zaleel karne wale azaab hain.
ayahs.58: Aur jin logon ne raah-e-Khuda mein tark-e-watan kiya phir woh shaheed kar diye gaye ya apni maut mar gaye Allah Taala unhein behtareen rizq ata farmaayega. Aur beshak Allah Taala rozi dene walon mein sab se behtar hai.
ayahs.59: Unhein Allah Taala aisi jagah pahunchaayega ke woh us se raazi ho jaayenge, beshak Allah Taala ilm aur burdbaari wala hai.
ayahs.60: Baat yehi hai, aur jis ne badla liya isi ke baraabar jo us ke saath kiya gaya tha phir agar us se ziyaadati ki jaaye to yaqeenan Allah Taala khud us ki madad farmaayega. Beshak Allah darguzar karne wala bakhshne wala hai.
ayahs.61: Yeh is liye ke Allah raat ko din mein daakhil karta hai aur din ko raat mein daakhil karta hai, aur beshak Allah sunne wala dekhne wala hai.
ayahs.62: Yeh sab is liye ke Allah hi haq hai aur us ke siwa jise bhi yeh pukaarte hain woh baatil hai aur beshak Allah hi bulandi wala kibriyaai wala hai.
ayahs.63: Kya aap ne nahin dekha ke Allah Taala aasman se paani barsaata hai, pas zameen sar-sabz ho jaati hai. Beshak Allah Taala mehrbaan aur ba-khabar hai.
ayahs.64: Aasmanon aur zameen mein jo kuchh hai isi ka hai aur yaqeenan Allah wahi hai be-niyaaz tareefon wala.
ayahs.65: Kya aap ne nahin dekha ke Allah hi ne zameen ki tamaam cheezen tumhare liye musakhkhar kar di hain aur us ke farmaan se paani mein chalti hui kashtiyan bhi. Wahi aasman ko thaame hue hai ke zameen par us ki ijaazat ke baghair na gir pade, beshak Allah Taala logon par shafqat-o-narmi karne wala aur mehrbaan hai.
ayahs.66: Isi ne tumhein zindagi bakhshi, phir wahi tumhein maar daalega phir wahi tumhein zinda karega, beshak insan albatta na-shukra hai.
ayahs.67: Har ummat ke liye hum ne ibaadat ka ek tareeqa muqarrar kar diya hai, jise woh baja laane wale hain pas unhein is amr mein aap se jhagda na karna chaahiye aap apne Parwardigar ki taraf logon ko bulaaiye. Yaqeenan aap theek hidayat par hi hain.
ayahs.68: Phir bhi agar yeh log aap se ulajhne lagen to aap keh den ke tumhare aamaal se Allah ba-khoobi waaqif hai.
ayahs.69: Beshak tumhare sab ke ikhtilaaf ka faisla qayamat wale din Allah Taala aap karega.
ayahs.70: Kya aap ne nahin jaana ke aasman-o-zameen ki har cheez Allah ke ilm mein hai. Yeh sab likhi hui kitaab mein mahfooz hai. Allah Taala par to yeh amr bilkul aasaan hai.
ayahs.71: Aur yeh Allah ke siwa un ki ibaadat kar rahe hain jis ki koi Ilahi daleel naazil nahin hui na woh khud hi us ka koi ilm rakhte hain. Zaalimon ka koi madadgaar nahin.
ayahs.72: Jab un ke saamne hamare kalaam ki khuli hui aayaton ki tilaawat ki jaati hai to aap kaafiron ke chehron par na-khushi ke saaf aasaar pehchaan lete hain. Woh to qareeb hote hain ke hamari aayaten sunaane walon par hamla kar baithen, keh dijiye ke kya main tumhein is se bhi ziyaada badtar khabar doon. Woh aag hai, jis ka wada Allah ne kaafiron se kar rakha hai, aur woh bahut hi buri jagah hai.
ayahs.73: Logo! Ek misaal bayan ki ja rahi hai, zara kaan laga kar sun lo! Allah ke siwa jin jin ko tum pukaarte rahe ho woh ek makkhi bhi to paida nahin kar sakte, go saare ke saare hi jama ho jaayen, balke agar makkhi un se koi cheez le bhaage to yeh to use bhi us se chheen nahin sakte, bada booda hai talab karne wala aur bada booda hai woh jis se talab kiya ja raha hai.
ayahs.74: Unhon ne Allah ke martaba ke mutaabiq us ki qadr jaani hi nahin, Allah Taala bada hi zor-o-quwwat wala aur ghaalib-o-zabardast hai.
ayahs.75: Farishton mein se aur insanon mein se paighaam pahunchaane walon ko Allah hi chhaant leta hai, beshak Allah Taala sunne wala dekhne wala hai.
ayahs.76: Woh ba-khoobi jaanta hai jo kuchh un ke aage hai aur jo kuchh un ke peechhe hai, aur Allah hi ki taraf sab kaam lautaaye jaate hain.
ayahs.77: Aye imaan walo! Ruku sajda karte raho aur apne Parwardigar ki ibaadat mein lage raho aur nek kaam karte raho taake tum kaamyaab ho jaao.
ayahs.78: Aur Allah ki raah mein waisa hi jihad karo jaisa jihad ka haq hai. Isi ne tumhein barguzida banaaya hai aur tum par deen ke baare mein koi tangi nahin daali, deen apne baap Ibraheem (alaihis salaam) ka qaaim rakho, isi Allah ne tumhara naam musalman rakha hai. Is Quran se pehle aur is mein bhi taake Paighambar tum par gawaah ho jaaye aur tum tamaam logon ke gawaah ban jaao. Pas tumhein chaahiye ke namazen qaaim rakho aur zakaat ada karte raho aur Allah ko mazboot thaam lo, wahi tumhara wali aur maalik hai. Pas kya hi achchha maalik hai aur kitna hi behtar madadgaar hai.
